$comment: Gzipped budgets for representative consumer imports, in bytes.
These encode the library's tree-shaking guarantees: a consumer that uses one
generator must not pay for 27, and a background layout must not pay for the
'import' is bundled from dist/ with esbuild (minified, ESM, react external,
code splitting on) and only the ENTRY chunk is measured — lazily loaded chunks
are excluded on purpose, since that is what a first paint actually downloads.
Run `npm run size` locally, or `npm run size -- --update` to re-baseline after
an intentional change. Budgets carry ~4% headroom over the measured value so
minor zlib/toolchain drift does not fail CI.
